test_runs.selector: Exact cross-lane determinism, typed relations/conflicts, authority, budgets, schema parity, and immutable-PV integration
negative_cases: Implicit, duplicate, or unsupported lane sets fail closed.
Unsupported relation types and incomplete immutable authority fail closed.
Aggregate budgets cannot starve later explicit lanes.
Worker completion order cannot change ranking domains or receipt identity.
Cross-lane budgeting cannot regress the Row216 parallel API default.
Parallel completion order, dedupe, timeout, and cancellation remain sealed.

test_runs.selector: Lane guidance, reader, lane contract, registry, and packaged-skill integration
negative_cases: The typed join primitive cannot weaken single-lane authority or registry contracts.
Packaged skill references remain bound to canonical installed identities.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, schema parse, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check; py_compile; json.tool; git diff --check
negative_cases: Malformed Python, schema JSON, or whitespace cannot pass.
No Git, install, helper, tunnel, candidate, HIL, pointer, or root-spawned subagent action is included.

limitations: Row217 exposes the internal typed cross-lane primitive only; explicit cross-project querying remains Row218.
Public skill and MCP routing remains Row221.
The historical TASK_CONTRACT_AMENDED projection regression remains outside this row.
